title: Three Evenings and One Short Pen
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：ink　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ink 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the writer ① used the ink that no reader in the study would have described, and he said the using was the whole of the evening. The ② ink, meaning the word itself and not the pen, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; ink, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of ink in that study had the same short pen beside it, and the ④ ink at the far desk, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Ink, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the writer said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the ink was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the word. The ⑥ ink, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; ink, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both word and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ ink had become a line in a page, and the page had become an argument about the short pen. The ⑧ ink of the whole thing, the writer wrote in March, was one study and three evenings of describing; ink, he said, is either the page at the far desk or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ink I remember is the ink described in the page, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the study. ⑩ Ink, my mother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being described; all ink, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like word. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 墨水；墨迹（指书房里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 墨水；墨迹（指那瓶文字本身，与钢笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the ink 使用这种墨水
D. n. 墨水；墨迹（指留给孩子们抄的那一页那一瓶）
E. n. 写作之事（抽象总称，指一处书房的墨水之事）
F. n. 墨水；墨迹（指册页里写到、被记下的的那一瓶）
G. n. 声音、表达（指一件事里人人都写却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 表达（抽象总称，指人人都写却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the ink that no reader in the study would have described
The ink, meaning the word itself and not the pen
Every kind of ink in that study
the ink at the far desk
the ink was the whole of the matter
the ink had become a line in a page
The ink of the whole thing

answers.why: use the ink 意为“使用这种墨水”，1966 年那位作者把书房里没有一位读者肯描述的一瓶墨水做了一遍。
ink 意为“墨水；墨迹”，指那瓶文字本身而不是钢笔，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
ink 意为“墨水；墨迹”，指书房里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支短短的钢笔。
ink 意为“墨水；墨迹”，指最远那张书桌留给孩子们抄的那一页那一瓶，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
ink 意为“声音、表达”，指一件事里人人都写却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种声音就是那件事的全部。
ink 意为“表达”，指人人都写却无人提起的那样东西而不是那瓶文字，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
ink 意为“墨水；墨迹”，指册页里写到、被记下的的那一瓶，到 1971 年这一瓶成了册页里的一行。
ink 意为“写作之事”，作者三月写道，整件事的墨水之事是一处书房和三个夜晚的描述。
ink 意为“墨水；墨迹”，我记得的是册页里描述过的那一瓶，1973 年用尽了，至今仍被说成书房里最安静的一瓶。
ink 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，墨水是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的文字。
